comments.author: tare
comments.body:
Sadly, the skull next to a pirate's photo really means nothing these days. The pirate can simply farm off an alt or a group of alts just for the nice skull. Usually when someone relogs and sees a pirate again after being bitten, they would immediately logout and not come back for many hours to shake off the pirate but if someone keeps relogging in and attempts to sail and gets attacked so frequently, something is amiss. KOEI may need to prevent farming by making the logoff carry the immunity via the basis of real world 24 hour time.

Back to main topic, Light La Mort as an adventure ship seems to be a good idea due to the sails and EA (to try to run out of unsafe ports quickly) but is there a better ship for such a purpose to quickly escape ports ?

comments.author: Maruku
comments.body: Will the type of skill (original/optional) matters on the type of material ship if i wan to inherit EA? (on top of my 3 skills-1 orig 2 opt?)

comments.author: valduin
comments.body:
Sorry
you can inherit EA on any ship
you cannot inherit RA DHP EM

comments.author: valduin
comments.body:
So you have many options for adding EA on the LLM
1 as optional
2 as skill inherit
3 as skill addition
it really depends which one is the best alternative on what skill set you want to achieve and how you are planning your fusion for that ship.

comments.author: ReaD
comments.body:
to add what valduin said
1. as optional, you obtain the skill by doing FS improve
2. as skill inherit, you obtain EA by slave ship that have EA from ship rebuild(and select EA as skill when doing g0 to g1)
3. as skill addition, you pick this by ship rebuild...but you need to FS improve it afterward because this only give 1 more slot(total of 3 optional slot)..

comments.author: Armie
comments.body:
A decent LLM for high-speed piracy needs to have EA on optional so that Fusion Bonus can be Speed Up 1 , 2 at G3.

A decent LLM mod (122 row, 11+ wave, 20+ turn, 125+ sails, -25% ship hold) needs 3 D-gaff, 3 Dstorms.

D-sails are 700m each.

Without using d-sails, you still can build it, but nowhere close to storm-proof and 20+ turn while having -25% (which introduces -5 wave penalty).

Everyone who has done pirating knows the importance of -25% in contrast to -20%. :)
